verdict.rationale: Filee ships its own documented CLI, `filee convert` with `--to` or `--preset`, which uses the app's conversion engines and presets and offers `--json` output and defined exit codes for scripts. That covers the core conversion function programmatically, but nothing shows parity with the UI, and no HTTP API exists (OpenAPI probes all 404). Missing for 10: evidence that UI-only features (interactive crop/aspect dial, preset and toolbar configuration, watch-folder setup, PDF merge ordering, engine management) are scriptable; a documented API with stated UI parity; independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: "filee convert <files, wildcards or folders> --to <format>" (or "--preset <preset>") converts with the app's engines and presets
"--json" prints the result for scripts; exit codes are 0 (nothing failed), 1 (some files failed), 2 (wrong arguments or a missing input) and 3 (nothing to convert).
